topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I can't fathom how they could just shut down the place like it's nothing. Every wall held stories, every seat a memory. They say the food wasn’t just taste; it was a promise kept, day after day. Now, they tell us it’s just business, move along. Well, I refuse. This isn’t a matter of numbers on a sheet; it’s about hearts, families, the place where you go to heal after a bad day. They took that away, and for what? Progress, they say, but it feels more like amnesia. They forget, but I won’t. I’ll keep the flavors alive, even if it’s just in my thoughts.
